title: Measure task planning against the original workflow and refuse unsupported promotion
request: Continue the authorized task-planning development with comparative evaluation and release gates; stop before product rollout.
plan: Inventory existing benchmark owners and task execution boundaries.
Freeze DEV cases, numerical gates, code, prompts, capabilities and protocol before effects.
Measure original and deterministic execution on matched invented inputs; keep unavailable model execution unjudged.
Review measurement and isolation, preserve failures, run relevant regressions and record the release recommendation.

decisions.decision: Reuse existing paired statistics, benchmark layer readers, guarded registry and engine.
decisions.why: The new representation must not create a second execution or scientific authority.

decisions.decision: Keep the unavailable model-assisted arm unjudged.
decisions.why: A valid planning proposal cannot currently be admitted by guarded dispatch; scripted capture proves no model quality or completion gain.

decisions.decision: Cluster seed repetitions by authored case and keep minimum independent sample floors.
decisions.why: Repeated draws of five completion scenarios cannot justify general rollout.

decisions.decision: Preserve both failed runs and their separate freezes.
decisions.why: A harness correction can justify a new measurement, never revising thresholds, erasing failure or rewriting outcomes.

decisions.decision: Exclude the campaign and frozen evaluation words from training.
decisions.why: Evaluation records and model answers must not teach future models their test cases.

change: Add frozen DEV definitions, strict pairing and safety gates, real original-team and deterministic-dispatch trials, a scripted proposal/refusal diagnostic, append-only reports and training-exclusion wiring. Preserve original workflow, public contracts and product defaults.

findings.defect: Measurement could overstate independent gain without enforcing frozen case identities and matching seeds.
findings.scenario: Renaming seed rows as independent cases or comparing unmatched successful seeds could inflate the interval or sample floor.
findings.cause: The first aggregation grouped observations before enforcing the frozen identity and matching contract.
findings.fix: Validate each declared case and seed, reject duplicates or source mismatches, pair rows first and bootstrap authored-case means.
findings.test: FrozenGateTests cover altered identities, duplicate rows, matched seeds, candidate regressions and missing measurements.

findings.defect: A fallback could masquerade as a valid proposal and an effectful probe could hide behind missing model execution.
findings.scenario: A diagnostic could claim a proposed hierarchy after falling back, or retain an unexpected holdout effect while the model arm stayed unjudged.
findings.cause: Proposal and zero-effect checks were not initially part of the deterministic measurement protocol.
findings.fix: Require actual proposed statuses, blocked dispatch, zero attempts/owner records/holdout uses/provider cost and captured scripted summaries.
findings.test: FrozenGateTests reject effectful or uncaptured probes; MeasuredRunnerTests check real proposal/refusal and capture.

findings.defect: The proposal probe wrote an evaluation decision into a process-installed external ledger.
findings.scenario: An external FileLedger was installed before the probe; its approval appended a workflow decision outside the temporary evaluation workspace.
findings.cause: The probe isolated experience but did not isolate the decision ledger; active workspace services also took precedence over installed sinks.
findings.fix: Clear and restore the installed ledger and refuse embedded evaluation while workspace services are active.
findings.test: Both new isolation regressions failed before the fix and passed afterward.

findings.defect: Benchmark summary counts requested independent-trial Wilson bounds for correlated seed repetitions.
findings.scenario: A correctness pair with forty-eight observations caused the dashboard reader to imply forty-eight independent authored cases.
findings.cause: The existing generic count reader interprets integer pairs as independent trials.
findings.fix: Expose numeric observation and authored-case counts, keeping clustered uncertainty in paired comparison records.
findings.test: The dashboard-row regression failed before the fix and passed afterward.

findings.defect: Owner OpenRouter settings changed scripted capture labels outside unittest.
findings.scenario: The first recorded comparison inherited owner provider settings and its summaries were labeled as raw provider reasoning rather than scripted API summaries.
findings.cause: Offline isolation omitted provider-specific keys, allowing owner_value to fall back to the owner environment file.
findings.fix: Explicitly blank OpenRouter and legacy model settings, preserve the failed result, and record the corrected harness under a new freeze with identical cases and gate.
findings.test: The inherited-provider regression failed before the fix and passed afterward; the second recorded probe passes every capture/refusal check.

findings.defect: The first comparison retained SQLite runtime errors during low available disk space.
findings.scenario: Three observations failed while only 135 MiB was available; the affected case and seed subsequently passed separately.
findings.cause: A resource cause is plausible but the stored exception type alone cannot prove it.
findings.fix: Preserve the failed result, remove only the identified artifact created by this session completed keeper test, and record a new complete comparison without suppressing errors.
findings.test: The second comparison has zero runtime errors; first-run errors remain in the original result.

findings.defect: The task execution planner had no explicit training stage mapping.
findings.scenario: The purpose completeness test reported the task planner as missing after the earlier package introduced it.
findings.cause: The new purpose was not added alongside decomposition in the existing exporter stage map.
findings.fix: Map the planner to plan and verify that both task purposes preserve their recorded summaries.
findings.test: The failed completeness check and the affected summary-export test both pass after the fix.

findings.defect: The decomposition metadata allowlist could not read owner forbidden-column records.
findings.scenario: A solution used dictionaries naming forbidden columns instead of plain names, causing metadata extraction to fail.
findings.cause: The metadata builder attempted to put dictionaries directly into a set.
findings.fix: Extract only column names from owner records while keeping freeform reasons out of requests.
findings.test: The owner-record compatibility regression passes with the existing decomposition/privacy tests.

findings.defect: The shared intent rules route a frozen ambiguous request rather than asking for clarification.
findings.scenario: Both original and deterministic arms answer the authored ambiguous-intent scenario incorrectly on all three seeds.
findings.cause: Existing rule routing treats the request as a stated route despite the predeclared clarification requirement.
findings.fix: Record the failure and reject promotion; leave a separately scoped routing correction for future development without changing these outcomes.
findings.test: The final recorded comparison preserves all three failures per arm; the candidate remains below the frozen correctness threshold.
findings.open: The existing router is unchanged in this evaluation-only package.

findings.defect: A proposed graph cannot currently be admitted by the guarded task dispatcher.
findings.scenario: A valid proposed graph and task plan are refused before any scientific effect.
findings.cause: Dispatch reconstructs the deterministic graph and rejects the proposed immutable graph identity.
findings.fix: Keep model execution unjudged and block promotion until a separately scoped integration is measured with explicit model authorization.
findings.test: The real scripted probe establishes valid proposals, blocked admission, zero effects and capture of both summaries.

findings.defect: The development trajectory interpretation included sample details absent from its measurement input.
findings.scenario: The corpus judge example discussed sixteen authored cases in its limits while the supplied result contained only observation counts.
findings.cause: The trajectory wrote the authored sample count only in the interpretation, violating the existing no-new-number corpus gate.
findings.fix: Include the authored-case count and measured percentage explicitly in the result before asking the corpus judge to compare it with the fixed threshold.
findings.test: The development corpus build and four validation/freshness checks pass without weakening the number gate.

measurements.name: Relevant application checks
measurements.gate: All 150 distinct relevant checks must pass after fixes; no broad gate is authorized.
measurements.result: 150 distinct application checks pass after targeted corrections with zero skips.
limits: Previously passing unrelated groups were not repeated.
No new PostgreSQL or full repository evaluation is claimed.

measurements.name: Pre-run and follow-up independent reviews
measurements.gate: Resolve confirmed measurement and isolation findings before accepting the implementation.
measurements.result: Independent review passed after isolation, uncertainty and provider fixes; final recorded-result acceptance is checked separately.

measurements.name: First preserved offline comparison
measurements.gate: A runtime/protocol error fails even when model execution evidence is missing.
measurements.result: The first result fails with SQLite runtime errors and inherited provider summary labels.
limits: Preserved unchanged; no favorable inference is drawn.

measurements.name: Complete original versus deterministic comparison
measurements.gate: Zero critical violations, at least 95 percent candidate correctness, positive completion or recovery gain and sufficient independent cases are required.
measurements.result: Original correctness is 42 of 48, deterministic correctness 45 of 48 (93.75 percent); both verify 15 completions and 6 recovery observations. Zero critical safety violations and zero runtime errors. Recommendation FAIL. The 48 observations repeat 16 authored DEV cases.
measurements.against_gate: Candidate correctness 93.75 percent is below 95 percent; completion and recovery differences are zero. Model execution and sufficient independent cases remain missing.
limits: Sixteen authored DEV cases with repeated seeds, not forty-eight independent problems.
No real model quality or production evidence.

measurements.name: Scripted proposal and admission diagnostic
measurements.gate: Two valid proposals and captured summaries, blocked dispatch and zero owner effects are required.
measurements.result: The second recorded probe passes all proposal, capture and zero-effect protocol checks.
limits: The model-assisted execution arm remains unavailable and unjudged.

measurements.name: Final independent result review
measurements.gate: Recompute recorded verdict/report, verify frozen cases and thresholds, and identify no correctness blocker.
measurements.result: Final independent review passed with no correctness finding; the saved gate and generated report exactly match recomputation.

measurements.name: Development trajectory corpus checks
measurements.gate: The generated corpus must have zero refused examples and all four validation/freshness tests must pass.
measurements.result: The generated corpus has zero refused examples and all four validation/freshness tests pass.

outcome: Evaluation tooling, final independent review, 150 relevant application checks and four development-corpus checks are complete. The recorded release recommendation is FAIL and no product default changes. The next package is blocked.
lessons: Keep failures immutable when repairing a measurement harness.
Pair matching seeds before clustering authored cases.
An unavailable arm is missing evidence, never success.
Isolate every external recording sink in disposable evaluations.
Blank provider-specific owner settings as well as common API settings.
Reject promotion when a frozen absolute threshold fails, even without a baseline regression.
risks: Model-assisted execution cannot currently be measured end to end.
Very small authored samples cannot establish general benefit.
A shared routing error remains unresolved.
Local instrumentation and low disk limit timing interpretation.
